_doc: Opt-in baseline for `node scripts/check-all.mjs --baseline scripts/check-all-baseline.json`. Lists the checks EXPECTED to fail on a partial container checkout because the DEPLOY build chain regenerates them (pure structural idempotency: 'would update N files/hashes'). With the baseline, check-all exits 0 on 'zero NEW regressions' and reds only on an UNEXPECTED fail — so a session/agent can trust the exit code instead of re-deriving 'which of the 25 are idem noise' by hand every time. The plain `check-all.mjs` (no flag) stays STRICT; THAT is the Cloudflare deploy gate — never weaken it. RULES: (1) only add a check here if it is a deploy-regenerated builder whose ONLY container-failure mode is 'output would be rebuilt' — NEVER a hard gate (the runner denylists honesty/correctness gates and refuses a baseline that names one). (2) Each entry carries a dated reason. (3) If a baselined check PASSES, the runner warns to prune it (keeps this list honest). Regenerate the set by running `node scripts/check-all.mjs`, confirming each red is a 'would update' regenerator, and copying its label here. NOT baselined on purpose (they flag SEMANTIC data drift, not idempotency, so they stay visible even though the cost-index-refresh workflow also heals them): 'Cost-index picker' (a stale dollarRef flag vs the seed) and 'Cost-index revisions sync' (published readings moved on the 07-13/07-15 reads).
